description: One decision per authored AEM component property (www.stryker.com), applied to every page. handling = what the importer does today; proposal = what it should do; status = proposed | approved | rejected. The review table is generated from this file and the exports: node tools/importer/migration-index/property-table.js → tools/importer/decisions/property-table.md.

vocabulary.map: carry it with a new or existing option / section style (new names need approval)
vocabulary.normalise: use the template default instead of the per-page value
vocabulary.drop: no visible effect, nothing to carry
vocabulary.later: belongs to a template or dynamic component not built yet

standaloneimage.preset.how: the DM preset stays in the image URL (?$max_width_1440$)

standaloneimage.enableBorder.how: the 1px image border is lost (496 images have it on)
standaloneimage.enableBorder.proposal: map: a section style for bordered images (name to approve, e.g. image-border); colour from borderColor

standaloneimage.borderColor.how: only visible when enableBorder is true
standaloneimage.borderColor.proposal: map with enableBorder: one border colour per corp colour (teal default, grey, black); other values rounded

text.gradientDirection.how: direction of a background gradient; without a gradient background it renders nothing
text.gradientDirection.proposal: drop (the rare gradient boxes: see backgroundColor)

text.hideComponent.how: hidden components are not imported (live page decides)

text.topPadding.how: % padding of the text box; template spacing instead
text.topPadding.proposal: normalise (spacing validator to find the cases that matter, then a spacing section style)

text.leftPadding.how: % inset of the text box; matters inside coloured boxes
text.leftPadding.proposal: normalise; inside a coloured box use the box's own padding

text.topMargin.how: % margin above the text box (negative values pull it up)

text.leftMargin.how: % margin left (20% = an indented narrow box)
text.leftMargin.proposal: normalise; the 20% indent (57 uses) to review as a layout option

text.backgroundColor.how: gold and the greys become section styles (bg-gold, bg-light-gray, bg-gray, bg-dark-gray); white, blue, dark gold, slate are dropped
text.backgroundColor.proposal: map every corp colour: white box (matters on images / coloured panels), blue, dark gold, slate as section styles (names to approve); transparent = drop

text.showDimensionalBox.how: dimensional box recognised; no own look
text.showDimensionalBox.proposal: map to a section style (shadow box), name to approve

largeheadline.backgroundColor.how: as text.backgroundColor: gold / greys only; the white box behind hero text (environmental-programs) is lost
largeheadline.backgroundColor.proposal: map as text.backgroundColor; in a hero slide the box behind the text (Hero Corp option, name to approve)

largeheadline.topPadding.proposal: normalise (box padding from the section style)

largeheadline.leftMargin.how: % margin left; -25 (14 uses) pulls the box over the next column

curatedcta.CTAButtonColor.how: gold → Bold + Italic link (gold button); teal, purple, blue, others → Bold link (teal button)
curatedcta.CTAButtonColor.proposal: map purple (187 uses) and blue (32) buttons too (convention or section style, name to approve)

standalonevideo.type.how: the video source (DM path or id) becomes the Video block link

standalonevideo.hideBorder.how: videos with a border (853) render without
standalonevideo.hideBorder.proposal: map: the corp Video block keeps the source border by default, hideBorder = no border (option, name to approve)

standalonevideo.loopVal.proposal: map: autoplay + loop = a background-style video option (name to approve), as hero video slides

dam/components/scene7/dynamicmedia.asset.how: VideoAVS → video link, image sets → image link (dm-images transformer)

dam/components/scene7/dynamicmedia.s7Vie.how: AEM viewer preset; EDS renders its own player

disclaimer.disclaimer-type.how: text disclaimers imported (page facts); path (17) = a disclaimer taken from another page: to verify
disclaimer.disclaimer-type.proposal: keep text; path: resolve to the referenced text

marketoform.afterSubmitAction.how: thank-you message / redirect from the page facts

marketoform.marketoInstance.how: the form base URL / Munchkin ID the live page loads

fullbleedpanel.backgroundColor.how: the rendered panel classes (bg-light-gray, gradients, bg-gold, …) become section styles; colours without a class (e.g. rgb(89,75,97), rgba(62,82,69,1)) to verify
fullbleedpanel.backgroundColor.proposal: map every panel colour to a corp colour section style (names to approve for new ones)

jumpbarnav.hideComponent.how: hidden = not imported; visible = Sticky Nav

jumpbarnav.deactiveNav.proposal: verify on the example pages; likely not rendered = skip

pagehero.headColor.how: page hero title colour: gold (481), black (10)
pagehero.headColor.proposal: map gold title (colour tag) if the live title is gold

pagehero.usethumbnail.how: page hero shows the page thumbnail as image

pagehero.hideBottomLine.how: no gold rule = no border-bottom option

carouselslidegroup/carouselslide.mobileO.how: mobile_Bottom → text-below; mobile_Overlay → text over the image

carouselslidegroup/carouselslide.vertica.how: top-<n> / bottom-<n> option from the rendered top:%

carouselslidegroup/carouselslide.backgro.how: the slide's text box background (white in 452 of 463)
carouselslidegroup/carouselslide.backgro.proposal: map with largeheadline.backgroundColor: the box behind the slide text (Hero Corp option, name to approve)

carouselslidegroup.backgroundNav.proposal: drop (no rotation: one Hero Corp per slide)

carouselslidegroup.hcpBannerTextColor.proposal: drop (hcp-banner metadata is set; the banner has one look)

carouselslidegroup.localNav.how: local page nav over (15) or under (2) the hero
carouselslidegroup.localNav.proposal: keep the nav as Sticky Nav; position normalised

carouselslidegroup.carouselOptionAutopla.proposal: decide: multi-slide carousels stay one Hero Corp per slide (no rotation), or a carousel block

fullWidthImage.dimensionBox.how: text box style on the banner image (FDB / ND)

fullWidthImage.layoutOptions.how: col-sm-N → right-<n>, 50_bottom / 50_top → bottom / top options (Hero Corp image-slide, text-above)

fullWidthImageHero.hideBottomLine.how: no gold rule under the hero

filteredcontenttypegrid.listSize.how: product / procedure grid filled by a query (no handler yet)
filteredcontenttypegrid.listSize.proposal: later: product grid block with the query and page size

resourcesanddownload.jumpbarHidden.how: resources list not in the jump bar

sectionseparator.sectionColor.how: every separator becomes the divider style (grey rule); white-hr (69) is a white rule
sectionseparator.sectionColor.proposal: white-hr: verify if it is visible (white on white); if not, a section gap only

numbercounter.fontColor.how: gold / navy / teal / purple colour keyword

numbercounter.fontSize.how: number size in vw (2.5–8vw); Statistics has one size
numbercounter.fontSize.proposal: normalise, or size options like Hero Corp size-<n> (decide)

numbercounter.numberCounterAlignment.proposal: map left alignment as a Statistics option (name to approve)

contentFragment.elementNames.how: the fields each use shows (Cards contact fragment)

localpagenavigation.childrenNumber.how: how many child pages the local nav lists
localpagenavigation.childrenNumber.proposal: verify against the Sticky Nav (local) output

localpagenavigation.hideTopLine.how: no rule above the local nav
